learningPoint.zh: 原生四主面通过config.agent选择真实角色，运行时加载不同prompt、技能子集、委派白名单与写入策略；访谈规划、批准计划指挥、深度实现和全域统筹不是换名。七个委派专用面仍不计数。
learningPoint.en: Four native primary faces select real roles through config.agent, loading different prompts, skill subsets, delegation allowlists and write policies: interview planning, approved-plan conducting, deep implementation and broad orchestration are not renames. Seven delegation-only faces remain uncounted.

selectedReason.zh: 纠正reviews.json中四主面尚待角色映射的暂缓，而非推翻内部角色排除：清单注册四个preset，补丁的agent字段进入Runtime.agentId，再进入loadAgentPrompt、systemPrompt及实际角色权限/技能注册。Sisyphus为全域统筹，Hephaestus为受限派工的深度实现，Prometheus写域限.omd/并交接批准计划，Atlas不直接write/edit而指挥批准计划。四者是主会话入口；名字相似的slim只有一个原生预设，hawk只有命令/技能，无同构重复。
selectedReason.en: Resolves only the four-primary role-mapping hold in reviews.json, not the internal-role exclusions: declared preset agent fields flow through Runtime.agentId, loadAgentPrompt, systemPrompt and real permission/skill registration. Sisyphus is broad orchestration; Hephaestus deep implementation with restricted delegates; Prometheus .omd/-limited interview planning and approved-plan handoff; Atlas conducts an approved plan without direct write/edit. All four are primary session entries. Slim has one differently composed native preset; Hawk has commands/skills rather than native presets, so shared vocabulary is not isomorphism.

learningPoint.zh: 防守指挥台把事实库、任务队列和授权范围分开约束；外部日志/样本作为不可信数据，改配置前记录回滚值。七个明确不要手选的worker不计独立用户预设。

learningPoint.zh: 窄调度器只交自包含任务给不可恢复的外部子代理，区分返回任务id与真正完成通知，等待期间不得重复派单。
learningPoint.en: A narrow dispatcher sends self-contained tasks to non-resumable external workers, distinguishing job IDs from completion notices and preventing duplicate dispatch while waiting.

selectedReason.zh: 窄调度器只交自包含任务给不可恢复的外部子代理，区分返回任务id与真正完成通知，等待期间不得重复派单。
selectedReason.en: A narrow dispatcher sends self-contained tasks to non-resumable external workers, distinguishing job IDs from completion notices and preventing duplicate dispatch while waiting.

learningPoint.zh: 清理先只读发现、分风险等级、出manifest，再按明确确认删除；优先回收站，不能把检查或模糊同意当删除授权。

selectedReason.zh: 清理先只读发现、分风险等级、出manifest，再按明确确认删除；优先回收站，不能把检查或模糊同意当删除授权。

learningPoint.zh: 把只读规划与写入实施分别交给不同provider；只分析请求不强派执行，用户明确不要规划时允许直接实施通道。
learningPoint.en: Assign read-only planning and implementation to different providers; do not force execution for analysis-only requests, and allow an explicit user request to skip planning.

selectedReason.zh: 把只读规划与写入实施分别交给不同provider；只分析请求不强派执行，用户明确不要规划时允许直接实施通道。
selectedReason.en: Assign read-only planning and implementation to different providers; do not force execution for analysis-only requests, and allow an explicit user request to skip planning.

learningPoint.zh: 专用provider及作用域同名遮蔽限制唯一执行工具，任务书提前补足范围/禁改项/验收，避免子代理不能追问时靠猜。
learningPoint.en: Use a dedicated provider and scoped shadowing to constrain the execution surface, supplying scope, prohibitions and acceptance up front when workers cannot ask follow-ups.

selectedReason.zh: 专用provider及作用域同名遮蔽限制唯一执行工具，任务书提前补足范围/禁改项/验收，避免子代理不能追问时靠猜。
selectedReason.en: Use a dedicated provider and scoped shadowing to constrain the execution surface, supplying scope, prohibitions and acceptance up front when workers cannot ask follow-ups.

learningPoint.zh: 把专属绘图工具严格留在drawing预设，先状态自检与查规范tag再让用户确认提示词，不给通用模式平添工具噪声。
learningPoint.en: Keep drawing tools inside the drawing preset, checking environment and canonical tags before confirming prompts, instead of adding tool noise to general modes.

selectedReason.zh: 把专属绘图工具严格留在drawing预设，先状态自检与查规范tag再让用户确认提示词，不给通用模式平添工具噪声。
selectedReason.en: Keep drawing tools inside the drawing preset, checking environment and canonical tags before confirming prompts, instead of adding tool noise to general modes.

learningPoint.zh: 纯声明式组合降低升级面；文档描述当前事实，不把未经确认的实现偏差写成业务规则，提交推送仍需明确指示。
learningPoint.en: A configuration-only composition narrows upgrade exposure; document current facts without turning unapproved implementation drift into business policy, keeping commits/pushes explicitly authorized.

selectedReason.zh: 纯声明式组合降低升级面；文档描述当前事实，不把未经确认的实现偏差写成业务规则，提交推送仍需明确指示。
selectedReason.en: A configuration-only composition narrows upgrade exposure; document current facts without turning unapproved implementation drift into business policy, keeping commits/pushes explicitly authorized.

learningPoint.zh: 绘图能力来自用户导出的API工作流，先发现实际模型/slots再选提示词与参数；区分改图、反推与纯问答，反推后等待用户确认，失败重跑有上限。
learningPoint.en: Drawing capability comes from user-exported API workflows: discover actual models/slots before choosing prompts and parameters; distinguish edits, reverse prompting and questions, require confirmation after reversal, and bound retries.

selectedReason.zh: 真实manifest补丁插入Host桥和独立preset-draw/id draw；Host index.js注册五个draw_*工具，配置子树完整可追踪。和已计drawing不是同构fork：drawing把19个comfyui_*工具限定在预设、内置Anima/Krea2与角色tag/LoRA规则；draw是宿主全局五工具的空工作流框架，按用户API JSON/sidecar识别slots、不带模型管线，且persona、规划/工具树不同。
selectedReason.en: The actual manifest patch inserts the host bridge and a separate preset-draw/id draw; index.js registers five draw_* tools and the complete preset subtree is traceable. It is not isomorphic to accepted drawing: drawing scopes nineteen comfyui_* tools and supplies Anima/Krea2/tag/LoRA policies; draw is a host-wide five-tool empty workflow framework with user API JSON/sidecar slot discovery, no model pipeline, and a different persona/planning/tool tree.

learningPoint.zh: 将目标/基本点/硬软需求与任务树挂钩，按任务类别读画像而非灌入全部；UI对齐栏样式与正文分离。
learningPoint.en: Bind goals, principles and hard/soft requirements to a task tree, load profiles by task category, and style alignment metadata separately from answer content.

selectedReason.zh: 将目标/基本点/硬软需求与任务树挂钩，按任务类别读画像而非灌入全部；UI对齐栏样式与正文分离。
selectedReason.en: Bind goals, principles and hard/soft requirements to a task tree, load profiles by task category, and style alignment metadata separately from answer content.

learningPoint.zh: 按大型实施、小型实施、只读分诊，避免每次继续或追问都重开完整流程；用户纠正立即作废旧任务书，门禁按风险分级。
learningPoint.en: Triage large implementation, small implementation and read-only work instead of restarting the whole workflow on follow-ups; invalidate briefs on user correction and grade gates by risk.

Unlike accepted ppt-assistant's engine scripts/full file execution, it operates OOXML via stateful element ids, templates and native tools, not translation or renaming.
